title: Painted vanity unit with three drawers
summary: A three-drawer vanity unit in moisture-resistant MDF, with a hole for the basin waste and a top drawer shaped around the pipe.
intro: A freestanding vanity unit for a bathroom. Three deep drawers with brass handles, a hole in the top for the basin waste, and a box built into the middle of the top drawer so it slides past the pipe. I made it in moisture-resistant MDF, the green board in the build photos, and it was then painted a soft cream.

cover.alt: Cream painted vanity unit with three drawers and brass handles

steps.title: Built in green board
steps.text: Moisture-resistant MDF is the green board. It costs a bit more than normal MDF but it is the right thing for a bathroom.

image.alt: The vanity unit built in green moisture-resistant MDF, handles on

steps.title: A drawer that misses the pipe
steps.text: The top drawer has a box in the middle, so the waste pipe from the basin drops straight through and the drawer still slides.

image.alt: Top drawer pulled out, showing a box built round the space for the pipe

steps.title: Hole for the waste
steps.text: A hole through the top lines up with the basin waste and the gap in the drawer below. Then it was off to be painted.

image.alt: The top of the unit with a round hole for the basin waste
